blueprint_concepts: Identifying a conic from the general second-degree equation (h^2 - ab, Delta)

concept_use.Rotation of axes: The axes are rotated through theta with tan 2theta = 24/7 to remove the xy term, giving 50X^2 - 25Y^2 = 1250.
concept_use.Identifying a conic from the general sec: h^2 - ab > 0 and Delta != 0 identify the curve as a (non-degenerate) hyperbola, and the positive coefficient gives the transverse axis.

english: Consider the curve $23x^2+72xy+2y^2=1250$. Then the square of the distance between its foci is ______.
hindi: वक्र $23x^2+72xy+2y^2=1250$ पर विचार कीजिए। तब इसकी नाभियों के बीच की दूरी का वर्ग ______ है।
solution_full: $\Delta=abc+2fgh-af^2-bg^2-ch^2=c(ab-h^2)=-1250(46-1296)\neq0$, so the curve is not a pair of lines; $h^2-ab=1296-46=1250>0$, so it is a hyperbola. With no first-degree terms its centre is the origin.

To remove the $xy$ term rotate the axes through $\theta$ with $\tan2\theta=\dfrac{2h}{a-b}=\dfrac{72}{21}=\dfrac{24}{7}$. Taking $2\theta$ acute, $\cos2\theta=\frac7{25}$, so $\cos\theta=\frac45$, $\sin\theta=\frac35$.
So $50X^2-25Y^2=1250$, i.e. $\dfrac{X^2}{25}-\dfrac{Y^2}{50}=1$, with transverse axis along $X$, $a^2=25$, $b^2=50$.
$c^2=a^2+b^2=75$, the distance between the foci is $2c=10\sqrt3$, and its square is $300$.
originality_note: New: a hyperbola with an xy term whose rotation angle has tan 2theta = 24/7, so the rotation is exact and the new coefficients 50 and -25 are integers; the question is about the foci, so the student must identify the type and the transverse axis first (way 5). Closest known: textbook rotation of 7x^2 - 6 sqrt3 xy + 13y^2 = 16 (an ellipse). Different because: a different conic with different coefficients, and the focal distance requires knowing which axis is transverse.
stem_review: Read as a student: every point, line, curve and symbol is introduced before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently with sympy/mpmath (and a numerical brute-force check), is unique and equals the Answer Plan. The stem says 'curve' and does not reveal the type. Changed: No change.
key_step: Identifying the hyperbola and rotating through tan 2theta = 24/7 to get 50X^2 - 25Y^2 = 1250.
justification: Standard identification and rotation with clean numbers; a routine multi-step computation. Comparable to 2025-P2-Q4 (L2) on hyperbola parameters.
